what_it_is: The King of Fighters '97 NVRAM state (FB1 FS1, compressed) written by the libretro FB Alpha 2012 Neo Geo build on an Anbernic RG40XXH; game state unknown
attribution: from the repo path only: 'rg40xxh/sdcard/saves_RA/Roms/NEOGEO/FB Alpha 2012 Neo Geo/kof97.fs'. The 'fba2012neogeo' folder is the save subdirectory that core creates; nothing else on the page names the core or the game state
note: The Neo Geo-only build (fbalpha2012_neogeo) of the same FB Alpha 2012 core; RetroArch named the folder after its library name
